posting.description:
Davis Cartage Co. is hiring a full time Local Class A CDL Driver in Corunna, MI. 



Enjoy steady, year-round work, weekly pay, and weekends off with a well established, family owned company that has served the transportation, warehousing and logistics industry since 1941. 



 



Position details:



Monday through Friday



Day shift



Approximately 10-14 hours per day



Average annual pay of $75,000



Weekly pay



Local routes primarily throught Michigan



Most weekends off , with occasional Saturday work- typically only 3-4 Saturdays per year



Well maintained equipment



Our fleet includes Freightliner Cascadias, day cabs, sleepers, and 53' dry vans.



 



Benefits include:



Medical, dental, and vision insurance



401k with company match



Paid time off



Disability insurance



Life insurance



Monthly safety bonuses



Safe, reliable equipment



Company shirts and jacket



 



Qualified candidates must have 2 years of verifiable experience, a clean MVR and pass a drug screen and physical. 



To learn more about Davis Cartage Co., please visit www.daviscartage.com and follow us on Facebook.



 



Join a company that values safety, dependable service, and the drivers who make it all possible. 



Apply today to become part of the Davis Cartage team! (989) 743-4445 ext. 274
